name: anim_hira_riseA
subject: a very tall, extremely muscular horse man made of glossy brown paint with messy cream swirls
desc: The flat brown paint puddle heaves and squelches up into a heavy hunched mound: thick paint swells, bubbles bulge and pop, sticky strands stretch, the shapes of a broad back and big shoulders bulge up under a thick sagging layer of paint, the head still buried. Slow, heavy, sticky, viscous, gooey.
